LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: A single income or expense transaction in the user's ledger.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this entry.

type.description: Transaction type: 'in' for income, 'out' for expense.

dateStr.description: Transaction date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

description.description: Optional note or description of the transaction.

clientOrder.description: Epoch millisecond tie-breaker for chronological sorting on the same day.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation and updates.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: User-scoped income and expense ledger entries.
